textline.data: The actors in the use case diagram shall be modeled
in accordance with defined actor rules.
Direct associations between actors
shall not be permitted.
Non-human actors shall be represented using the
rectangular Actor stereotype notation.
Human actors shall be represented
using UML stickman notation.
Redundant associations between an actor and included
sub-use cases shall not be created unless the actor
independently initiates the included use case.
Each actor shall be associated with at least one
valid use case within the system boundary.
The actor names shall not be
proper nouns.
Each actor name shall be unique
within the use case diagram.
Each actor shall be represented as a
singular noun denoting a generic role.
The Use cases in the use case diagram shall conform
to defined use case modeling rules.
A use case shall not exist
without a valid connector.
Each use case shall be placed
inside the system boundary.
The use case name shall end with a singular or
plural noun representing a valid object.
Each use case shall be associated with
at least one actor or another use case.
Each use case name shall be
grammatically correct.
Each use case name shall be unique
within the use case diagram.
Each use case name shall be meaningful
and non-empty.
Each use case shall be named using
a Verb + Noun structure.
Relationships in the use case diagram shall
conform to defined UML relationship rules.
The Invalid source-target combinations between
model elements shall not be permitted.
The generalization relationship shall originate from
the child element and target the parent element.
The generalization relationship shall occur only
between compatible element types.
The extend relationship shall reference a valid
extension point defined in the base use case.
The extend relationship shall represent
optional or conditional behavior.
The extend relationship shall originate from the
extending use case and target the base use case.
The include relationship shall represent mandatory
behavior executed as part of the base use case.
The include relationship shall originate from the
base use case and target the included use case.
Model elements in the use case diagram shall conform to defined
representation and formatting rules.
Actors shall be placed outside
the system boundary.
Use cases shall be placed inside
the system boundary.
Articles within use case labels
shall be written in lowercase.
Conditional extension text shall be grammatically
correct and clearly written.
Use case and actor labels shall
follow Title Case formatting.
The system boundary shall be named
using a noun phrase.
